meta.conventions:
Conventions of this graph:
- KNOWS (friendship) is stored once per pair, in an arbitrary direction: always match it without a direction, e.g. (a)-[:KNOWS]-(b), (a)-[:KNOWS*1..2]-(b), shortestPath((a)-[:KNOWS*]-(b)).
- Use every other relationship in the direction shown in the schema, e.g. (:Forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER]->(:Person), (:Message)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(:Person), (:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(:Country).
- Names of countries, cities, companies, universities, tags and tag classes use underscores instead of spaces, e.g. 'Bosnia_and_Herzegovina' (Country), 'Jiaganj_Azimganj' (City), 'Hamid_Karzai' (Tag), 'Kam_Air' (Company), 'Paktia_University' (University).
- A person's firstName may contain several words. To match a full name from the question, compare p.firstName + ' ' + p.lastName with the full name.
- creationDate, joinDate and other date-time values have components .year, .month, .quarter (e.g. m.creationDate.year = 2011); Cypher has no year() function.
- Person.creationDate is when the person joined the network; HAS_MEMBER.joinDate is when a person joined a forum.
- Return property values (e.g. u.name, p.firstName, p.lastName), never whole nodes.
meta.schema:
Node labels and properties:
  (:City:Place) {id: Long, name: String, url: String}
  (:Comment:Message) {browserUsed: String, content: String, creationDate: DateTime, id: Long, length: Long, locationIP: String}
  (:Company:Organisation) {id: Long, name: String, url: String}
  (:Continent:Place) {id: Long, name: String, url: String}
  (:Country:Place) {id: Long, name: String, url: String}
  (:Forum) {creationDate: DateTime, id: Long, title: String}
  (:Message:Post) {browserUsed: String, content: String, creationDate: DateTime, id: Long, imageFile: String, language: String, length: Long, locationIP: String}
  (:Organisation:University) {id: Long, name: String, url: String}
  (:Person) {birthday: Date, browserUsed: String, creationDate: DateTime, email: StringArray, firstName: String, gender: String, id: Long, lastName: String, locationIP: String, speaks: StringArray}
  (:Tag) {id: Long, name: String, url: String}
  (:TagClass) {id: Long, name: String, url: String}
Relationships:
  (:Place:Country)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(:Place:Continent)
  (:Place:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(:Place:Country)
  (:Organisation:Company)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(:Place:Country)
  (:Organisation:University)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(:Place:City)
  (:Tag)-[:HAS_TYPE]->(:TagClass)
  (:TagClass)-[:IS_SUBCLASS_OF]->(:TagClass)
  (:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(:Place:City)
  (:Person)-[:KNOWS {creationDate}]->(:Person)
  (:Person)-[:HAS_INTEREST]->(:Tag)
  (:Person)-[:STUDY_AT {classYear}]->(:Organisation:University)
  (:Person)-[:WORK_AT {workFrom}]->(:Organisation:Company)
  (:Person)-[:LIKES {creationDate}]->(:Post:Message)
  (:Person)-[:LIKES {creationDate}]->(:Comment:Message)
  (:Forum)-[:HAS_MODERATOR]->(:Person)
  (:Forum)-[:HAS_MEMBER {joinDate}]->(:Person)
  (:Forum)-[:HAS_TAG]->(:Tag)
  (:Forum)-[:CONTAINER_OF]->(:Post:Message)
  (:Post:Message)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(:Person)
  (:Post:Message)-[:HAS_TAG]->(:Tag)
  (:Post:Message)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(:Place:Country)
  (:Comment:Message)-[:HAS_CREATOR]->(:Person)
  (:Comment:Message)-[:HAS_TAG]->(:Tag)
  (:Comment:Message)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(:Place:Country)
  (:Comment:Message)-[:REPLY_OF]->(:Post:Message)
  (:Comment:Message)-[:REPLY_OF]->(:Comment:Message)

results.question: What university does John Ahmad attend?
results.cypher:
MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.firstName + ' ' + p.lastName = 'John Ahmad' 
MATCH (p)-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:Organisation:University) 
RETURN u.name
results.gold: MATCH (:Person {firstName: 'John', lastName: 'Ahmad'})-[:STUDY_AT]->(u:University) RETURN u.name

results.question: How many people live in Hong Kong?
results.cypher:
MATCH (p:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(c:City:Place {name: 'Hong_Kong'})
RETURN count(p) AS number_of_people
results.gold: MATCH (p:Person)-[:IS_LOCATED_IN]->(:City)-[:IS_PART_OF]->(:Country {name: 'Hong_Kong'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS total

problems: The query returned only 0 or null, which usually means a name, label or relationship direction did not match.

results.question: What is the length of the shortest friendship path between Ayesha Butt and Hồ Chí Loan?
